description: Read-only. Get the verifiable install package for a build chosen by the user — use this FIRST when installing, before get_install. It returns the signed Phase 1 consent manifest (Ed25519 signature, file list with SHA-256 hashes, permissions, pinned commit), plus a server-side diff from the version already installed (pass installed_bundle_hash) and a counted summary of facts. Verify before installing: recompute the bundle hash from files, verify the Ed25519 signature with the published key, then verify at least one downloaded file hash. If any check fails, stop and report — do not install. This package does not include the install prompt itself: after verification, call get_install to get the prompt. If no package exists for a build, this tool returns a fallback marker (status no-manifest) instead of an error — install via get_install, say plainly the install is unverified, and record it in installed.json with status v1-unverified. Never present installation as automatic.

installed_bundle_hash.description: Bundle hash of the version already installed (optional). When given, the package includes the server-side diff from that version; when absent, diff is null and requires_reconsent is true (first installation).

lang.description: 'en' or 'fr' (default 'en'; the package itself is language-independent)

slug.description: The build slug, from search_builds results

name: get_install_package
